subject: Proposal: Joint webinar with Ignite Consulting — 'Inference at Scale'
messages:
From: Elena Marino <elena@ignite-consulting.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: events@ignite-consulting.com
Date: Sun, 16 Mar 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Joint webinar — 'Inference at Scale'

Hi Laura,

I'm Elena from Ignite Consulting — we run a monthly field webinar series focused on AI infrastructure and productization. We recently finished a program on retrieval-augmented systems and the audience asked for a deep-dive on inference cost/perf tradeoffs. Given Redwood's focus on serving and cost controls, we'd love to partner on a 45-minute session called 'Inference at Scale: Keeping latency low and costs predictable'.

High-level ask: co-host a live webinar the week of May 12 (or a date that works for you), 30–45 minutes plus 10–15 min Q&A. Typical audience: 300–600 product/infra engineers, startups and mid-market. Ignite handles registration/production; we ask partners to provide one speaker (technical/product), a short 3–4 slide intro, and a 300–400 word blog swap and joint social promo. We can cover speaker honoraria up to $1,000 for consulting partners if needed.

Can you let me know interest and an availability window for a quick kickoff call this week? I attached a one-page format and our audience breakdown.

Thanks,

Elena Marino
Partnerships Lead | Ignite Consulting
elena@ignite-consulting.com
Attachment: ignite-audience-onepager.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Marino <elena@ignite-consulting.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 Mar 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Joint webinar — 'Inference at Scale'

Hi Elena — excited about this. Redwood would be interested in co-hosting. 

Quick answers up front: week of May 12 works for us (we prefer Tue/Wed mornings PT), we'll provide one technical speaker (Marissa) + a product brief. We can also produce the 300–400 word blog by our comms team and split social amplification.

Questions we have before confirming:
- Audience target and registration goal (Ignite owns registration but we want to set a performance KPI).
- Production model: live vs. pre-recorded with live Q&A (we prefer live).
- Any required contracts/SOW? We prefer a short co-marketing SOW and a simple speaker release.
- Logos, brand guidelines, and lead sharing policy (GDPR/consent).

Ben/Marissa — looping you both in to flag capacity & speaker prep. Marissa, can you confirm availability for May 13 or 14 AM PT and whether you want a prep session two weeks prior? Ben — can you advise marketing amplification budget (paid social + email send) for a co-promoted webinar?

Happy to do a 20-min kickoff call tomorrow if that helps.

Best,

Laura Bennett
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Mar 2025 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Proposal: Joint webinar — 'Inference at Scale'

(Internal)

Ben/Marissa — forwarding Elena's note. Key asks: speaker (Marissa), blog swap, lead sharing. My suggested play: Redwood owns 40% paid amplification budget, Ignite 60% (they're doing registration/production). We also ask for guaranteed attendee minimum of 250 or a credit toward future events if under. Marissa — are you ok with a 30–40 min technical deep-dive on batching/quantization/serving tradeoffs + 10–15 Q&A? If yes, let's book two 1-hr prep slots (3/31 and 5/5).

Ben — pls confirm $ allocation by EOD so Laura can confirm to Ignite. If we need to push back on attendee minimum, I'm fine stating a KPI rather than guarantee.

Thanks — Laura

> On Sun, 16 Mar 2025 at 09:12 Elena Marino <elena@ignite-consulting.com> wrote:
> > (original message included)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Marino <elena@ignite-consulting.com>, Sam Park <sam.park@ignite-consulting.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Mar 2025 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Joint webinar — 'Inference at Scale'

Hi Elena / Sam — thanks for the quick reply on audience. We're happy to confirm a co-hosted webinar on Wednesday, May 14 at 10:00 AM PT (45 min + 15 min Q&A). Marissa will be our technical speaker and I will introduce briefly on alliances/why this matters for product teams.

Please see requests / commitments below:
- Agenda: 10 min intro (Laura), 30 min deep-dive (Marissa), 15 min live Q&A.
- Prep: two prep calls (Mar 31, May 5) 30–45 min.
- Marketing: Redwood commits $2,500 to paid amplification (paid social + a sponsored email to our dev list). Ignite commits remaining promo + registration.
- Leads: Ignite to provide full lead export 48 hours after event in CSV; Redwood will consume per our privacy policy and will not share PII further without consent.
- Contracts: please send a short SOW and speaker release. We prefer DocuSign for signatures.
- Assets: we need Ignite logo (SVG), a one-line blurb for the blog swap, and the attached speaker bio.

I've attached a quick speaker bio for Marissa and a proposed 1-page agenda. If you can send a draft SOW and a production checklist, I will route for approvals.

Thanks — looking forward to this.

Laura Bennett
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-speaker-bio-marissa.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Elena Marino <elena@ignite-consulting.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Park <sam.park@ignite-consulting.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Mar 2025 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Joint webinar — 'Inference at Scale' — SOW + agenda attached

Laura / Team — great, thanks for locking the date. Attached are: 1) ignite-draft-agenda.pdf (we trimmed to 40 + 20 Q&A in case we need more time), and 2) co-marketing-sow-ignite-redwood.docx (3 pages) that covers budgets, deliverables, lead sharing, and cancellation terms.

DocuSign link for the SOW is here: https://app.docusign.com/some/signed/placeholder (please review & route). We will also upload logo assets to the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bIgniteRedwoodShared

Notes on a few SOW items we flagged for transparency:
- We list a registration performance KPI of 300 opt-ins; if under 250 Ignite will issue a credit for $1,000 toward a future co-marketing activity.
- Ignite handles production, recording, and host follow-up; Redwood to provide speaker slides and 300-word blog within 5 business days post-event.
- We include a mutual publicity clause and ask for lead export 48 hours after event in CSV with opt-in consent column.

I'll await the signed SOW. Looking forward to the session — Elena

Elena Marino
Partnerships Lead | Ignite Consulting
